import torch
def _first(r):
    if isinstance(r, torch.Tensor): return r
    if isinstance(r, (tuple, list)):
        for x in r:
            if isinstance(x, torch.Tensor): return x
    return r
B0 = torch.tensor([False, True], dtype=torch.bool).reshape([2])
B1 = torch.tensor([True, False, True, False], dtype=torch.bool).reshape([4])
B2 = torch.tensor([True], dtype=torch.bool).reshape([1])
B3 = torch.tensor([4], dtype=torch.uint8).reshape([])
B4 = torch.tensor([1.0, 1.0], dtype=torch.float32).reshape([2])
LEAVES = [B0, B1, B2, B3, B4]
def g(B0, B1, B2, B3, B4):
    n0 = _first(torch.ops.aten.masked_scatter.default(B0, B2, B1))
    n1 = _first(torch.ops.aten.squeeze_copy.dim(n0, 0))
    n2 = _first(torch.ops.aten.select_scatter.default(n1, B3, 0, 1))
    n3 = _first(torch.ops.aten.detach_copy.default(n2))
    n6 = _first(torch.ops.aten.gelu.out(B4, approximate='none', out=torch.empty((2,), dtype=torch.float32)))
    n7 = _first(torch.ops.aten.glu.out(n6, 0, out=torch.empty((1,), dtype=torch.float32)))
    return (n7,)
